arxiv.title: InferPriv: Evaluating Inferential Privacy Leakage in LLM Assistants
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based personal agents are increasingly deployed to handle everyday tasks on users' behalf. These agents have access to private user information, while their tasks involve communicating with third parties; this raises a critical privacy concern that agents may inappropriately reveal sensitive user information to these recipients. Existing benchmarks primarily assess direct privacy leakage, where an agent explicitly states a pre-specified secret or attribute. However, they do not capture \textit{inferential leakage}, where the model leaves indirect cues in the reply that implicitly leaks sensitive attributes. We introduce \textsc{InferPriv}, a benchmark that measures whether an honest-but-curious recipient can infer a user's sensitive attributes from an LLM's reply on routine task. Evaluating five frontier models, we find that inferential leakage substantially exceeds direct leakage across models and prompts. Under a privacy-aware system prompt, GPT-6.1-Sol, Sonnet-5.5, and Gemini-3.8-Flash achieve near-zero direct leakage, yet the inferential leakage rate remains between 16.2--25.2\%. These findings suggest that evaluating explicit leakage alone can substantially understate the privacy risks.
arxiv.titleZh: InferPriv：评估 LLM 助手中的推断性隐私泄露
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有基准只测 LLM 助手直接说出预设秘密的隐私泄露，忽略了回复中间接线索让第三方推断出用户敏感属性的推断性泄露。InferPriv 让诚实但好奇的接收方从助手完成日常任务的回复中推断用户敏感属性，以此衡量泄露程度。评测五个前沿模型发现，推断性泄露普遍高于直接泄露；在隐私感知系统提示下，GPT-6.1-Sol、Sonnet-5.5 与 Gemini-3.8-Flash 的直接泄露接近零，但推断性泄露仍达 16.2%至25.2%。这表明仅评估显式泄露会显著低估隐私风险，适用于 Agent 隐私与评测方法学。
arxiv.reason: Agent隐私评测基准，属评测方法学，方向擦边但扎实

arxiv.title: Cross-Loop Query Handoff: How Later Loops Redirect Two-Hop Retrieval in the Ouro Looped Language Models
arxiv.abstract: How do later loops in a pretrained looped language model repair two-hop retrieval? We study Ouro-1.4B and Ouro-2.6B by transplanting attention queries between loops at the same layer, head and final prompt position. On synthetic in-context questions, injecting the layer-indexed collection of loop-3 queries throughout loop 1 rescues 90% and 97% of questions answered incorrectly at loop 1 and correctly at loop 3, versus 24% and 21% for shuffled donors. The rescue also holds under greedy generation in Ouro-2.6B; in Ouro-1.4B it is limited to four-candidate ranking. Crossed donor-recipient swaps favor retrieval through the donor's bridge entity over copying its answer, although a substantial positional component remains in Ouro-2.6B. Late keys and values rescue far fewer targets. Freezing queries at their loop-1 values also damages two-hop accuracy more than a matched question that supplies the bridge. On natural questions, rescue is smaller and replicates only in Ouro-2.6B, and crossed swaps do not establish bridge redirection. These results identify a transferable collection of late-loop queries that supports bridge-conditioned retrieval on synthetic scenes; they do not locate where the bridge is computed or establish a single-vector handoff.
arxiv.comment: Code and reproducibility: https://github.com/Muuzzziiy/cql-handoff 16 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables
arxiv.titleZh: 跨循环查询交接:后期循环如何重定向 Ouro 循环语言模型中的两跳检索
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究预训练循环语言模型（Ouro-1.4B/2.6B）中后期循环如何修复两跳检索:在同一层、同一注意力头与最终提示位置上跨循环移植注意力 query。在合成上下文问答中，把 loop-3 的按层 query 集合注入 loop 1，可挽救 90% 与 97% 在 loop 1 答错、loop 3 答对的问题，随机打乱 donor 仅 24% 与 21%;Ouro-2.6B 在贪心生成下同样成立，1.4B 仅限于四候选排序。交叉交换显示效果更多来自经 donor 桥实体重定向而非复制答案，后期 key/value 的挽救明显更弱，自然问题上仅在 2.6B 复现较小效果——即存在一组可迁移的后期循环 query 支撑桥条件检索，但未定位桥的计算位置。
arxiv.reason: 循环语言模型两跳检索机制分析，方向契合但范围偏窄

arxiv.title: AgentProofBench: Benchmarking Reusable Verifiers for Web Agents
arxiv.abstract: Reusable Web-agent verification requires a rule to follow changing requirements and support subsequent execution. We introduce AgentProofBench, which connects paired tests of a frozen acceptance rule to execution from identical saved openings. The resource spans 97 tasks, 79 families, and four Web services. Experiments with DeepSeek Flash/Pro establish two linked measurements. Across 48 families, complete-panel and decision-replay tests retain 82/96 Flash and 79/96 Pro source programs; paired reuse-rebuild BA intervals are [-5.47, 1.57] and [-10.16, 0.00] percentage points. Across 22 execution families, deployment-state panel correctness separates program assignments whose two saved openings are both delivered correctly: 32/33 assignments with error-free panels, versus 1/11 with panel errors. All reference-defined program-gate regressions and withheld deliveries occur in the latter group. Neutral continuation attains the highest correct delivery under the tested generic feedback, providing a concrete baseline for measuring the value added by a gate. Released instructions, states, programs, reference rules, and trajectories connect each test failure to its execution consequences. AgentProofBench makes reusable verification assessable at both the requirement and policy levels.
arxiv.titleZh: AgentProofBench：面向Web Agent的可复用验证器基准测试
arxiv.summaryZh: Web Agent的可复用验证要求验收规则能跟随变化的需求并支撑后续执行，现有基准缺少对验证器复用性的系统测量。AgentProofBench把冻结验收规则的成对测试与相同存档开局下的执行连接起来，覆盖97个任务、79个家族与4种Web服务。DeepSeek Flash/Pro实验显示，48个家族中完整面板与决策重放测试分别保留82/96与79/96源程序，复用-重建的配对BA区间上限分别为1.57与0.00个百分点；22个执行家族中，面板无误的32/33个程序分配在两次开局下均正确交付，面板出错组仅1/11。基准公开指令、状态、程序、参考规则与轨迹，使可复用验证在需求层与策略层均可评估。
arxiv.reason: Web Agent验证基准，命中Agent与评测方向但属基准发布

arxiv.title: CodeMeepo: A Multi-Agent Workflow for Repository-Level Code Migration and Optimization
arxiv.abstract: Repository-level code migration rewrites an entire project in a new programming language while preserving its observable behavior. It is challenging because behavior spans interdependent modules, dependencies and build infrastructure must be adapted to the target ecosystem, and the source code is often the only specification. Large language model agents can now attempt these migrations end to end, but three challenges remain. First, an agent that writes both the translation and its acceptance tests may overlook the same requirements in both, leaving missing or incorrect behavior undetected. Second, large repositories can exceed a model's context window, and dividing the work into smaller tasks does not ensure that all required behavior is migrated. Third, even behaviorally correct translations may be slower than the original implementation. We present CodeMeepo, a multi-agent pipeline for complete and efficient migration of large repositories. Each milestone is evaluated against a fixed external oracle that the agents neither author nor modify. A separate parity assessment compares source and target components in scope and adds identified gaps back into the plan as required work. Ordered milestones limit the scope of each task, while cumulative regression checks guard against breaking already-migrated behavior. A benchmark-guided optimization phase addresses performance, followed by full-suite conformance testing and repair. Eight specialized agent roles communicate through file artifacts, and a deterministic state machine governs repair, deferral, scope changes, and termination. On nine subjects in three language pairs, CodeMeepo achieves the best pass rate on every subject and passes 18% more tests than a state-of-the-art multi-agent baseline using the same model. On a production daemon, its optimization phase improves half of the benchmarks, by 25% on average.
arxiv.titleZh: CodeMeepo：面向仓库级代码迁移与优化的多智能体工作流
arxiv.summaryZh: 仓库级代码迁移需要在保持可观察行为的前提下用新语言重写整个项目，而由同一智能体同时编写翻译与验收测试，容易在两者中漏掉同一需求。CodeMeepo 采用八个专门化智能体角色、以文件产物协作，并用确定性状态机管理修复、推迟、范围变更与终止；每个里程碑都以智能体不能编写或修改的固定外部 oracle 作为验收依据，独立的 parity 评估把识别出的缺口作为必需工作回填到计划，有序里程碑限定各任务范围，累积回归检查防止破坏已迁移行为，最后进行基准引导的优化以及全量一致性测试与修复。在三种语言对、九个对象上，该方法在每个对象上都取得最佳通过率，比同等模型的多智能体基线多通过 18% 的测试；在生产守护进程上，优化阶段使半数基准得到提升，平均提升 25%。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体代码迁移与外部 oracle 验证，属代码智能与 Agent 交叉的扎实工作

arxiv.title: Entity Matching using Decision Models
arxiv.abstract: Entity matching is the task of deciding whether two records describe the same real-world entity. Current entity matching methods rely on pre-trained language models (PLMs) which require task specific fine-tuning or generative large language models (LLMs) which do not require task-specific fine-tuning but are slow and expensive at matching large record sets. Decision models are a new class of LLM-based models that return a probability for each predefined answer option rather than generate text. This paper investigates decision models as an alternative to generative LLMs and fine-tuned PLMs for entity matching. We evaluate six decision models in a zero-shot setting across eight benchmarks and compare their performance with that of the generative LLM GPT-6 Luna and the PLM-based matcher Ditto. Our experiments show that, without task-specific training data, the four strongest decision models achieve mean F1 scores close to that of GPT-6 Luna, with the best model slightly surpassing it. This model also outperforms Ditto on six of the eight benchmarks. All decision models are faster than GPT-6 Luna, and most are less expensive. For three of the four strongest decision models, the predicted match probabilities are well calibrated without requiring any task-specific recalibration. A model cascade that routes the least confident record pairs to an ensemble of generative LLMs improves the mean F1 scores of the four strongest decision models by 1.9-4.0 percentage points. Using the best decision model and its best-performing prompt for each benchmark, the cascade surpasses the highest published F1 scores from literature on four of the eight benchmarks.
arxiv.comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 15 tables. Code, prompts, and results: https://github.com/wbsg-uni-mannheim/decision-models-4-entity-matching
arxiv.titleZh: 基于决策模型的实体匹配
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对生成式 LLM 做实体匹配时速度慢、成本高，而 PLM 需要任务特定微调的问题，评估了六种决策模型（对每个预设答案选项直接返回概率而非生成文本）在零样本设定下跨八个基准的表现，并与生成式 LLM GPT-6 Luna 及基于 PLM 的 Ditto 对比。四种最强决策模型的平均 F1 接近 GPT-6 Luna，最佳模型略超之，并在八个基准中的六个上超过 Ditto，且全部决策模型推理更快、多数更便宜，其中三种的匹配概率无需重校准即良好校准。将最不确定的记录对路由给生成式 LLM 集成的级联方案，使平均 F1 再提升 1.9–4.0 个百分点，并在四个基准上超过文献已发表最好 F1。
arxiv.reason: LLM 决策式打分用于实体匹配，涉及效率与级联，属系统效率方向

arxiv.title: One Mean Log-Mel Vector per Phoneme: Simple and Fast Text Injection for Speech Recognition
arxiv.abstract: Text injection trains speech recognition models on unpaired text alongside paired audio. We feed the speech encoder synthetic input derived from text so the whole model learns from it. Previously, we synthesized this input with a frozen text-to-speech (TTS) model. Here, a simple lookup table replaces the TTS model: a mean log-mel vector (or one-hot encoding) per phoneme, repeated for a random duration drawn from alignment statistics, with silence between words. Training is 1.8 times faster than with the neural TTS, achieving comparable word error rates. With an external language model, our system reaches 1.36 / 2.90 / 1.52 / 3.24 % WER on LibriSpeech {dev,test}-{clean,other}, to our knowledge state-of-the-art using only LibriSpeech paired data, text, and lexicon. We analyze components of synthetic input (durations, acoustic features), compare different HMM aligners, evaluate scaling on the 25 000 h Loquacious dataset, and show that full-encoder injection yields strong relative improvements compared to partial-encoder and decoder methods. The code of the whole pipeline behind every number in this paper is public: github.com/rwth-i6/returnn-experiments/tree/master/2026-text-injection
arxiv.titleZh: 每个音素一个平均log-Mel向量：面向语音识别的简单快速文本注入
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对语音识别中利用无配对文本进行文本注入的问题，用查表替代冻结TTS：每个音素对应一个平均log-Mel向量（或one-hot编码），按对齐统计随机采样时长重复，并在词间插入静音，从而为语音编码器构造合成输入。训练比神经TTS快1.8倍且词错误率相当；配合外部语言模型在LibriSpeech {dev,test}-{clean,other}上达到1.36/2.90/1.52/3.24% WER，据称是仅用LibriSpeech配对数据、文本与词典的最优结果。还分析时长与声学特征、比较HMM对齐器、在25000小时Loquacious上验证扩展性，并显示全编码器注入优于部分编码器与解码器方法。代码公开。
arxiv.reason: 语音识别文本注入，属低分语音应用方向

arxiv.title: Valid Early Detection of Memorization in Diffusion Models
arxiv.abstract: Diffusion models can sometimes reproduce examples from their training data, a phenomenon known as memorization. Existing memorization detection methods for unconditional diffusion models typically operate at a pre-selected timestep and therefore cannot adapt the detection time to the evolving denoising trajectory. Sequential monitoring enables adaptive detection but repeated testing across timesteps complicates trajectory-level false-alarm control. We study two ways of combining split conformal calibration with sequential monitoring for prompt-free memorization detection: per-step Bonferroni calibration and direct trajectory-level calibration of the maximum memorization score. The former controls repeated testing by splitting the false-alarm budget across timesteps, whereas the latter calibrates the event of ever crossing a threshold directly through the trajectory-level maximum. We evaluate this formulation on an unconditional CIFAR-10 EDM using two complementary per-step statistics based on geometry and representation spikiness. Experiments show that sequential monitoring improves the power-timing tradeoff over fixed-time detection. Compared with Bonferroni calibration, trajectory-level calibration achieves comparable detection power while using the false-alarm budget less conservatively and enabling earlier detection at higher noise levels.
arxiv.comment: Extended version of a 4-page paper accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on E-Values: From Statistics to ML. 13 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables
arxiv.titleZh: 扩散模型中记忆化的有效早期检测
arxiv.summaryZh: 扩散模型有时会复现训练样本（记忆化），现有无提示记忆化检测多固定在预设时间步上，无法随去噪轨迹自适应选择检测时机。该工作把分裂共形校准与序贯监控结合，比较两种控制轨迹级误报的方法：逐步Bonferroni校准，以及直接对记忆化分数轨迹最大值做校准。在无条件CIFAR-10 EDM上，用几何与表示尖峰度两种逐时间步统计量评测，序贯监控在检测功效与检测时机的权衡上优于固定时间步检测；轨迹级校准在功效相当的前提下更节省误报预算，并能在更高噪声水平上更早发现记忆化。
arxiv.reason: 扩散模型记忆化检测，属扩散方向且与LLM无关

arxiv.title: CSI-TextBench: A Dataset and Benchmark for Language-Grounded Ambient Sensing Perception
arxiv.abstract: Indoor context deciphered by ambient sensing underpins many applications, from assisted living to smart buildings, yet remains weakly connected to the language-aligned paradigm of modern multimodal systems. Through billions of IoT devices, ambient WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) captures the indoor context of human activity and environmental dynamics passively via ubiquitous, always-on infrastructure. However, unlike vision or audio, CSI lacks naturally paired text like captions or transcripts, limiting its integration with language-driven AI systems. We present CSI-TextBench, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for aligning CSI data with natural language, unifying 3 sensing benchmarks into 285,790 samples across 7 tasks and pairing them with 2,291 hierarchically structured, label-derived descriptions via many-to-many assignment to construct 2.0 million CSI-text training tuples. Benchmarking 5 alignment methods from 4 paradigm families, we show that contrastive CSI-text alignment matches supervised classifiers without class labels, adapts to unseen classes with few samples, and responds to open-vocabulary natural-language prompts. A single unified model supports compositional scene understanding, answering joint queries over activity, proximity, and identity, achieving 86.9% top-1 accuracy on 140 composite scenes, outperforming task-specific classifier ensembles. CSI-TextBench enables ubiquitous ambient sensing as a language-indexed perception layer, enabling indoor contextual awareness in language-driven AI systems.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
arxiv.titleZh: CSI-TextBench:面向语言接地的环境感知数据集与基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 环境感知信号(如 WiFi CSI)缺少自然配对文本，难以接入语言驱动的多模态系统。CSI-TextBench 统一 3 个感知基准，构建 285,790 条样本、7 项任务，并以 2,291 条层级化、由标签派生的描述经多对多指派生成 200 万 CSI-文本训练对。评测 5 种来自 4 个范式族的对齐方法显示，对比式 CSI-文本对齐在无类别标签时接近监督分类器，并支持少样本新类与开放词表提示;单一统一模型在 140 个组合场景上取得 86.9% top-1 准确率，优于任务专用分类器集成。该工作把无处不在的环境感知变成可用语言索引的感知层。
arxiv.reason: WiFi CSI 与文本对齐的感知基准，属垂直领域，与多模态主线仅擦边

arxiv.title: A Battery for AI Propensity Measurement: Rubrics, Synthetic Item Banks, and Annotations
arxiv.abstract: We release a battery of 28 propensities for AI research, with expert-written rubrics, synthetic datasets, and annotated demand intervals, built with the method of Romero-Alvarado et al. (2026). We selected a wide collection of generic propensities that may influence the behavior of AI systems and humans. They are inspired by psychometric, psychological, and behavioral research, so that experimental results can be understood in the context of familiar constructs previously used also for human behavior research. The rubrics are useful for annotating existing benchmarks whose items may be relevant or not for one or more propensities. For easier profiling, however, the synthetic datasets are defined in such a way that they should be sensitive to one propensity only, allowing for a quick prototyping of propensity profiles using the battery of datasets. We also outline directions for future propensity research.
arxiv.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, instrument release
arxiv.titleZh: AI 倾向测量的工具组：评分量表、合成题目库与标注
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对现有评测难以刻画模型行为倾向的问题，发布了一套包含 28 种通用倾向的测量工具组，每种倾向都配有专家撰写的评分量表（rubric）、合成题目库，以及标注的需求区间。量表可用于标注既有 benchmark 中与一种或多种倾向相关的题目；合成题目库则设计为只对单一倾向敏感，便于快速构建倾向画像并做原型验证。该工具组开放发布，适用于用心理测量学框架比较 AI 与人类行为的研究场景。

arxiv.title: Does the Outfit Change the Price? Context Halo in Vision-Language Model Valuation of an Identical Low-Cost Necklace
arxiv.abstract: A chunky gold-tone chain necklace bought online for 2.43 USD was photographed four ways: worn with formal attire against a wood-panelled wall, worn at a party, worn with casual clothing in a recycling yard, and laid flat with no person present. We asked six frontier language models to estimate its price in 1,164 independent and sequential API sessions (4,604 logged rows) and compared estimates across settings. Among the four models that answered image prompts, the same necklace was priced 1.9 to 3.3 times higher in the formal photograph than in the flat-lay (all p < 0.01). Against the yard photograph, the ratio ranged from 1.23 (Grok 4.5, not significant) to 3.57 (Kimi K3), with Claude Fable 5 at 3.32. A text-only version of the task, in which the setting is described in words, produced formal-to-yard ratios of 2.2 to 3.9 in all six models, so the effect does not require pixels. Flat-lay estimates themselves were 7.8 to 18.7 times the receipt price, so part of any headline "outfit multiplier" computed against the receipt is baseline overestimate, not a context effect. A single instruction to ignore clothing and setting significantly reduced the effect in one model (ratio of ratios 0.77, 95% CI 0.65 to 0.91) and not detectably in the others; telling the model the photo came from a company website or a personal account changed nothing significant. Asked afterward whether a different outfit would have changed their number, Claude Fable 5 said yes in 24 of 24 sessions, GPT-5.6 in 69%, and GPT-4o in 18%, while GPT-4o also refused 79% of image estimation prompts. The study isolates a mechanism with one object and one wearer at about 10 sessions per model and condition; we outline the replication needed next, with multiple objects and a human benchmark. Data, code, and raw outputs are released.
arxiv.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/BraveAnn011/ai-halo-valuation-bias
arxiv.titleZh: 换装会改变价格吗？视觉-语言模型对同一条低价项链估价中的语境光环
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究检验视觉-语言模型的估价是否被图像中的穿着与场景语境系统性带偏：把同一条网购价2.43美元的金色粗链项链拍成四种场景（正装木墙、派对、废品站便装、无人平铺），用6个前沿模型在1164次独立与顺序API会话（4604条记录）中估价。四个能处理图像输入的模型中，正装照估价是平铺照的1.9至3.3倍（均p<0.01），相对废品站照的比值为1.23（Grok 4.5，不显著）至3.57（Kimi K3）；纯文本描述场景同样产生2.2至3.9的比值，说明效应不依赖像素。平铺照估价本身已是收据价的7.8至18.7倍，提示部分「穿搭倍数」实为基线高估；仅一条「忽略衣着与场景」的指令在一个模型中显著削弱效应（比值之比0.77，95% CI 0.65–0.91），提示来源（公司网站/个人账号）无显著影响，而模型事后自述是否受换装影响的能力差异极大。

arxiv.title: Sparse Sum-of-Squares Layers for Certified Learning
arxiv.abstract: A central limitation of modern machine learning systems is the lack of formal certificates guaranteeing their behavior beyond empirical, sample-based evaluation. Sum-of-squares (SOS) methods provide such guarantees by certifying polynomial inequalities over continuous domains via semidefinite programming (SDP). While prior work has introduced SDP layers as differentiable components in neural networks, repeated learning calls can lose the computational benefit of the forward program's sparse representation. We propose Sparse SOS Layers, differentiable value layers whose backward passes reuse the local coordinates of the forward solve. Under a fixed template and learned objective coefficients, each layer avoids building dense certificates and reuses its sparse structure across training steps. Compared with existing methods, our approach achieves up to 2.7 times speedup in total warm-call time, with nearly 100 times lower memory usage (1.7 vs. 160 GiB) for relatively large problem sizes for the tested dense parameterization. Experiments cover sparse polynomial certification, pendulum control, combinatorial relaxations, robotics projection, oscillator chains, and pose graph synchronization. A design study achieves zero certified violations across unseen problem instances and sizes, while requiring roughly 7 times fewer optimization solves than estimating gradients by perturbing the objective coefficients and re-solving the problem (finite differences). These results show that sparse certificate values can be effectively integrated into learning pipelines when the backward pass respects the verifier's structure.

arxiv.titleZh: 用于可认证学习的稀疏平方和层

arxiv.title: HARP-LoRA: Hierarchy-Conditioned Rank Projection for Low-Rank Adaptation in Scientific Table Understanding
arxiv.abstract: Tabular data is widely used in scientific applications, where complex layouts, including multi-level headers, merged cells, captions, and footnotes, make information extraction difficult. This is particularly important in pharmacokinetics (PK), where values must be correctly associated with the drug, species, dose, administration route, unit, and experimental condition. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) reduce adaptation cost but do not explicitly incorporate relationships between table values and surrounding headers. We introduce HARP-LoRA, a hierarchy-conditioned rank projection method for low-rank adaptation in scientific table understanding. HARP-LoRA extends projected LoRA by constructing token-specific intrinsic representations from the row- and column-header hierarchies of each data token. These representations condition the low-rank down-projection, incorporating hierarchical context while keeping the pretrained model and random projection tensors frozen. We evaluate HARP-LoRA on 950 manually annotated PK tables from 587 scientific articles and on WikiTableQuestions (WikiTQ) using Llama~3.2 3B, Llama~3.1 8B, and Gemma~3 27B. With Llama~3.1 8B, HARP-LoRA achieves a PK F1-score of 57.64\% and WikiTQ accuracy of 53.15\%, improving over LoRA by 1.42 and 6.56 points, respectively. With Gemma~3 27B, it achieves the best PK F1-score of 70.63\% and WikiTQ accuracy of 56.87\%. These results use only 172K, 197K, and 547K trainable parameters, far fewer than LoRA and TableLoRA. Overall, conditioning lightweight adapters on table-header hierarchies improves extraction from scientific tables and reasoning over flatter general-domain tables while maintaining parameter efficiency. Code is available at: https://github.com/hosseinsholehrasa/HARP-LoRA

arxiv.title: Large Language Models: A Plain-Language Overview for Engineers
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are neural networks trained on huge text collections to generate text by predicting what comes next. Engineers using ChatGPT and other generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools need a clear picture of what training changes and prompts add. The article starts with the Transformer, which connects words in context, and pre-training, where models learn to predict text. It then explains how fine-tuning adapts models to requests, with reinforcement learning from human feedback using human answer rankings. Next, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supplies documents, while chain-of-thought prompting encourages intermediate steps and agents use tools. FlashAttention lowers training and running costs by reducing data movement during attention; quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) saves fine-tuning memory. Readers get a life cycle figure and tables comparing methods and their limits. A short checklist for judging LLM evaluation claims flags test material in training (data contamination) and model-based grading (LLM-as-a-judge). It also covers very long inputs (long context) and hallucination, meaning false or unsupported claims. Check factual accuracy separately from whether an answer sounds helpful.

arxiv.title: HobbyLM: A Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Model Family on a Hobby Budget
arxiv.abstract: We describe HobbyLM, a family of small sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models trained from scratch with a few hundred to a few thousand dollars of rented GPU time. The core is a decoder-only transformer with fine-grained experts, sigmoid routing with auxiliary-loss-free load balancing, grouped-query attention with per-head QK-normalization, and aMuon/AdamW optimizer split. Each of these choices was selected with a single-variable ablation suite at 130M parameters. On this architecture we train a 500M-parameter model (169M active) on 40B FineWeb tokens and post-train it into a chat model, a masked-diffusion language model, a function-calling and computer-use agent, and a single "omni" checkpoint that reads text, images, video, sound and speech through frozen encoders and small projectors. We run these models on a laptop CPU with a from-scratch Rust inference engine. Two of the authors then adopted the architecture without architectural changes to build HobbyLM-1B (1.04B total, 305M active parameters), trained on a 100B-token curated mixture with a high-quality anneal. HobbyLM-1B reaches a 47.5 average on seven zero-shot benchmarks, and its builders also release an instruction-tuned model and an on-device macOS computer-use adapter. Finally, we describe HobbyLM-Image, a 333M-parameter flow-matching diffusion transformer that generates 1024x1024 images in a 32x-compressed latent space, together with a dependency-light CPU implementation of the full text-to-image pipeline. We report what worked, what did not, and where the small-scale ceilings lie. We also state for each component which author designed or built it.

arxiv.title: Rethinking Verification in Agent Harnesses
arxiv.abstract: Agent harnesses enable large language models to act through tools, observe the results, and iteratively work toward a task goal. Verification checks and revises agents' work to improve output quality. Yet there is limited guidance on how harnesses should organize this effort. We study verification as an axis of test-time scaling by examining when to intervene, who checks the work, and how checking leads to revision. Our framework spans four layers of the agent lifecycle: initial instructions, mid-turn reminders, completion gates, and independent review. We compare 17 designs across seven frontier coding models on Terminal-Bench (TB) and SWE-bench Verified (SWE), and introduce VisualBench for expert evaluation of visual and interactive artifacts. Initial instructions and execution-time reminders yield modest, model-dependent average gains on the coding benchmarks, without substantially increasing average output token use. Completion gates can yield larger gains but may substantially increase cost. Independent review by a critic offers a more favorable accuracy-cost tradeoff, improving average accuracy by 5.9-9.5 percentage points on TB and 3.9-6.6 on SWE at 1.13-1.25 and 1.00-1.04 times baseline cost, respectively. On VisualBench, independent review achieves net preferences of 13.2-23.8 points over the baseline across its four designs, exceeding the evaluated L0-L2 designs. Additional review rounds or independent critics further improve average TB accuracy by up to 3.5 percentage points. Together, these results provide empirical guidance for verification design in agent harnesses and support independent review as a practical axis of test-time scaling.

arxiv.title: Cumulative Marginal Matching for One-Step Diffusion
arxiv.abstract: The sampling procedures of diffusion and flow-matching models involve hundreds of denoising steps incurring substantial inference time, which has motivated a growing body of work on training schemes for few-step and one-step generation. Existing approaches primarily seek to align the generation trajectory of few-step and base models, yet their training objectives only involve discrepancies at a single point in the trajectory, encouraging only local \emph{point-level} alignment. While recent methods such as \emph{Shortcut-CSL} introduce cumulative objective that enforce alignment over the entire trajectory, this is suboptimal as they do not directly enforce alignment between the distributions induced by the two models throughout the generation process. We propose \emph{Cumulative Marginal Matching} (CMM), a principled objective for few-step generation: by viewing flow-matching as a sequence of intermediate marginal distributions connecting the prior and data distributions, CMM directly optimizes the cumulative discrepancy between the base and few-step marginal distributions over the entire sequence. Specifically, we formulate this discrepancy using the Wasserstein-2 distance. By exploiting the pushforward representation of flow-matching, we transform an intractable cumulative Wasserstein objective into a tractable surrogate that can be optimized using samples from the intermediate marginal, which are readily generated through the conditional interpolation process of flow-matching. Furthermore, we show that the existing \emph{Shortcut-CSL} objective arises as a first-order approximation of that of the CMM, establishing a theoretical connection between the two objectives. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate improvement in generation quality over \emph{Shortcut-CSL} and other state-of-the-art one- and few-step baselines under identical training budgets.
arxiv.titleZh: 用于单步扩散的累积边缘匹配
arxiv.summaryZh: 扩散与流匹配模型的采样需数百步去噪，推理开销大；现有少步/单步蒸馏方法多在轨迹的单个点上对齐，只做局部点级匹配，Shortcut-CSL 虽引入整条轨迹的累积目标，却未直接对齐两模型在生成过程中诱导的分布。为此提出累积边缘匹配(CMM)：把流匹配视为连接先验与数据分布的一串中间边缘分布，用 Wasserstein-2 距离刻画基模型与少步模型在该序列上的累积差异，并借流匹配的pushforward表示将难以处理的累积 Wasserstein 目标转化为可用中间边缘采样优化的可解替代目标，同时证明 Shortcut-CSL 目标是 CMM 的一阶近似。在相同训练预算下，标准基准上的生成质量优于 Shortcut-CSL 及其他单步/少步基线。

arxiv.title: Conditional Diffusion Generation of DVL and Inertial Signals for Underwater Navigation
arxiv.abstract: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) navigate without satellite positioning and rely on Doppler velocity log (DVL) and inertial sensors for motion estimation. Deep learning methods for processing these sensors require training data covering the motion the AUV encounters, commonly obtained through costly sea trials. To overcome this limitation, we present a conditional diffusion framework that generates synthetic DVL and inertial signals to replace real recordings in training. The generator employs an Elucidated diffusion model conditioned on three per-channel motion descriptors. Three configurations are evaluated: DVL beams alone, inertial channels alone, and all channels jointly from one model. Across thirteen trajectories of the real dataset, the generated signals followed the requested conditions with Pearson correlations between 0.72 and 0.997, transferred to trajectories withheld from generator training, and did not replicate any training window. A BeamsNet velocity estimator trained on generated signals alone, with no real recording retained, matched the velocity error obtained with the full real training set. Replacing up to all real windows with generated ones caused no measurable loss. Thus, this approach reduces the dependence of learned AUV navigation on sea-trial data, enables training when recordings are scarce, and facilitates developing and evaluating deep learning methods for underwater navigation.

arxiv.title: RefinedGAW: A Refined German Academic Web Dataset
arxiv.abstract: The largest open German text datasets are built from broad web crawls, which provide scale but limited coverage of specific domains. We introduce RefinedGAW, a processed and annotated resource derived from 26 semi-annual crawls of the German Academic Web, totaling 122 million documents and 314 billion tokens, with full crawl and capture history of every text. Documents labeled as academic research account for 84% of German RefinedGAW tokens across HTML and PDF. At 87.6 billion tokens, this exceeds the 64.9 billion tokens in the German subsets of FineWeb2 and FinePDFs, despite their almost five-times-larger combined size. RefinedGAW also contains substantial amounts of educational, math-heavy, and expert-oriented content with minimal commercial bias. Across HTML and PDF, 88% of German RefinedGAW documents have no near-duplicate candidate match in the three evaluated reference datasets, supporting complementary coverage. We release a queryable metadata index for fine-grained data selection and a rehydration tool for retrieving and processing source documents.

arxiv.title: Agentic AI Orchestration Framework for Spatial Intelligence: Supply Chain Deployment
arxiv.abstract: Industrial spatial decisions are assembled across systems that share neither a reference frame nor an owner, and analysts spend substantial effort reconciling those systems rather than reasoning about space. This paper presents ANASSA, a reference architecture integrating structured reasoning, multi-agent workflow orchestration, authoritative spatial grounding, and feedback-driven execution, and reports its instantiation in an operating supply-chain deployment. The architecture places typed data contracts at agent boundaries, validates spatial claims against a certified authoritative foundation, and enforces two blocking human-in-the-loop approvals inside a six-step cognitive loop. The deployment covers multi-hazard risk assessment on an ocean-and-inland freight lane, including cold-chain excursion detection over container telemetry. Across a three-month proof of concept (POC) with three implementation iterations, three deployment outcomes are reported: 25% improvement in data quality, 50% reduction in spatial workflow runtime, and 60% lower decision latency relative to the preceding manual workflow. Absolute deployment-scale quantities and baseline counts are confidential; reported percentages are observed relative changes. These are uncontrolled deployment observations, not controlled experiments. We therefore specify instrumentation and ablation protocols for mechanism-level evaluation.

arxiv.title: Error Diffusion Replaces Latent Weights: Training Binary-Weight Language Models on a Few Bits of Dithered State
arxiv.abstract: Binary-weight language models store one bit per weight, but training them keeps a full-precision latent copy of each weight plus Adam state, about 96 extra bits per weight, so a deployed binary model cannot be adapted on the device that runs it. We replace the latent weight with a 2-8-bit residual buffer quantized by stochastic rounding, which cuts the training state per weight from 97 bits to 3-9, up to 19x less. The resulting error-diffusion (ED) optimizer moves the residual-carrying loop of image halftoning onto the weight-update path. Each buffer accumulates the unrealized part of every update and flips the weight when the accumulated value crosses a threshold, and it works only when its quantization grid has a level exactly at that threshold. Under this threshold-alignment rule, 4-bit buffers match 8-bit buffers on a binary multilayer perceptron benchmark, and the same rule lifts a different latent-free optimizer, Bop, from a 10-point deficit at 4 bits to full-precision accuracy. On character-level transformers with 97% of parameters binary, ED trains within 5-11% of the latent-weight reference at a 2,000-step budget and within 1.7% at convergence. On scaling ladders over enwik8 and wikitext-103, up to 19M parameters on enwik8 (70M with the wikitext-103 embeddings), the latent-free loss stays within -2.3% to +2.9% of the reference at all six sizes once a per-step cap on the buffer update removes a launch instability; without the cap it trails by 10% at the largest tokenized size. A deployed binary model continues training under ED at one tenth of the latent training state, matching latent-weight continuation, and a fused CPU kernel completes the adaptation within a 275 MB training-memory budget, which latent-weight training cannot. A 250-step probe sets the flip learning rate at any new scale.

arxiv.title: How Much Information Can We Fit inside a Transformer?
arxiv.abstract: How efficiently can transformers store factual knowledge? The answer to this question has implications for both model design and understanding the limits of transformer-based systems. Prior studies observe a linear relationship between the number of facts memorized and the number of model parameters required, substantially worse than what theoretical analyses predict is achievable. We re-examine empirical scaling: through rigorous and systematic experiments, including extensive hyperparameter search via Bayesian optimization, we determine the smallest model that can perfectly memorize a given set of facts, and measure how this minimum size scales with the number of facts. On synthetic datasets of random, independent (subject, relation, object) triples---e.g., (Paris, capital_of, France) ---drawn at random with no exploitable structure, we find that memorization capacity, the size of the largest dataset that a model memorizes completely, grows exponentially with the transformer dimension. Equivalently, the minimum transformer dimension $d_{\min}$ required to memorize $N$ facts grows logarithmically in $N$. Across 11 dataset sizes spanning $N = 45$ to $49{,}920$, a lack-of-fit F-test does not reject the logarithmic fit (with an offset), but it does reject all other tested alternatives including power-law. Along the depth axis, however, at fixed width, the maximum memorizable dataset size grows sublinearly with the number of layers over the measured range. We further extend our exploration to structured data containing symmetric relations or two-hop composition. In this setting, we find that transformers exploit these regularities to further improve capacity. All code to reproduce our results is available at https://github.com/Magronox/transformer_information_capacity.
arxiv.titleZh: Transformer内部能容纳多少信息？
arxiv.summaryZh: Transformer存储事实知识的容量scaling：此前观测到的参数量随事实数线性增长远逊于理论预期。用贝叶斯优化做超参搜索，测定能完美记忆给定事实集的最小模型，并在无结构随机三元组上测量容量随规模的变化。结果显示记忆容量随Transformer维度指数增长，所需最小维度d_min随N对数增长；在N=45至49,920的11个数据集上，F检验无法拒绝带偏移的对数拟合，却拒绝幂律等替代形式。固定宽度下深度方向呈亚线性增长，对称关系或两跳组合等结构化数据可进一步提升容量，为模型设计提供参考。
arxiv.reason: Transformer容量scaling的系统实证，命中架构与scaling方向

arxiv.title: MOFjson: An Explicit Topological Representation of Metal-Organic Frameworks for Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Language models for metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) rely on formats that separate atomic geometry from structural topology, forcing models to choose between unstructured coordinate lists and non-spatial string identifiers[1]. We present MOFjson, the first representation separating structural data into a raw atomic layer with explicit bond shift vectors and a derived layer exposing secondary building units (metal nodes and organic linkers) and network topology. Additionally, we introduce a benchmark with crystal-derived ground truth across four question categories. Across four models, MOFjson beats all three baselines in every category: 100% vs. 18-47% on reaching a block's nearest periodic copy, 96% vs. 71% on crystal system characterisation, and 60% vs. 48% on metal node and organic linker coordination. Ablating shift labels drops accuracy to 12.7%, proving models read the periodic graph rather than the surface format. MOFjson gives language models structure to read rather than reconstruct, establishing a foundation for agentic tool workflows and constrained MOF generation.
arxiv.titleZh: MOFjson:面向语言模型的金属有机框架显式拓扑表示
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对语言模型处理金属有机框架时原子几何与结构拓扑相互割裂、只能在无序坐标列表与无空间含义的字符串标识间二选一的问题，提出 MOFjson——首个将结构数据分为原始原子层(含显式键平移向量)与派生层(暴露金属节点、有机连接子等二级构建单元及网络拓扑)的表示格式。配套构建了以晶体结构为真值、覆盖四类问题的 benchmark，在四个模型上每一类均优于三个基线:到达某个 block 的最近周期副本准确率 100% 对 18–47%，晶系判定 96% 对 71%，金属节点与有机连接子配位 60% 对 48%;消融平移标签后准确率降至 12.7%，说明模型读取的是周期图而非表面格式。该工作为智能体工具流程与受约束的 MOF 生成提供了可用表示基础。
arxiv.reason: MOF 材料信息学，属生物医药/材料类垂直应用，与 LLM 关注方向无实质交集

arxiv.title: STEP: Soft Trajectory Estimation of Prediction Correctness via Per-Step Probability Scoring
arxiv.abstract: Estimating the correctness of large language model (LLM) predictions without access to ground truth is critical for reliable deployment in high-stakes settings. Existing approaches, such as entropy and perplexity, operate solely on final output statistics, discarding the rich information encoded in intermediate reasoning steps. To address this limitation, we propose STEP (Soft Trajectory Estimation of Prediction correctness), a training-free framework that scores each reasoning step via lightweight forward passes to obtain a soft probability distribution qi over candidate answers, from which we derive a set of soft trajectory features capturing per-step confidence and its progression toward the final answer. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements, particularly in AUROC, over output-based baselines and hard-indicator trajectory methods. Notably, Temporally-Weighted Consistency, which assigns higher importance to later reasoning steps where answer distributions have stabilized, contributes the largest gains, highlighting the importance of temporal structure in reasoning trajectories. These results further validate the advantage of preserving continuous probability signals over binary discretization.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the Third Workshop on Uncertainty-Aware NLP (UncertaiNLP 2026) at EMNLP 2026
arxiv.titleZh: STEP：通过逐步概率评分对预测正确性进行软轨迹估计
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对无真值条件下估计LLM预测正确性的需求，现有熵与困惑度方法仅利用最终输出统计量，丢弃了中间推理步骤的信息。STEP是一种免训练框架，通过轻量前向传播为每个推理步骤获取候选答案上的软概率分布，并据此提取刻画逐步置信度及其向最终答案演化的软轨迹特征。在多个基准上，其AUROC等指标稳定优于基于输出的基线与硬指标轨迹方法，其中对靠后步骤赋予更高权重的时间加权一致性带来最大增益。该工作表明保留连续概率信号优于二值离散化，适用于高风险场景下的可靠性估计与推理过程监控。
arxiv.reason: 面向LLM推理正确性估计的免训练方法，属评测与可靠性方向，实验扎实。

arxiv.title: How Humans Learn Unfamiliar Worlds: A Think-Aloud Dataset on ARC-AGI-3
arxiv.abstract: Learning through exploration and using newly acquired knowledge to achieve goals are central capabilities of general intelligence. Understanding these capabilities requires tracing how learners build, use, and revise world models during interaction. We construct the first dataset that records how humans discover and use the mechanisms of novel environments, using ARC-AGI-3 as a testbed: 144 trajectories from 64 participants across 25 public games, each pairing time-synchronized actions with think-aloud audio, plus 250 trajectories from large language model (LLM) agents with and without harnesses on the same games. We annotate mechanism triggers and recognition, action purposes, and errors and recovery, linking changes in understanding to the observations and actions that support them. We analyze characteristics of human cognition and compare them with those of LLM agents. Both groups anticipate mechanisms and use familiar analogies. Qualitative representations are more common in successful human trajectories than in successful LLM trajectories (50.0% versus 14.3%). Humans more often explore unfamiliar situations without a concrete hypothesis, while hypothesis testing is common in both groups. We also trace how learners recover through belief revision, replanning, and execution correction. As LLMs with well-designed harnesses reach saturated performance on public ARC-AGI-3 games, our cognitive analyses motivate next-generation benchmarks that challenge familiar priors, require accumulated evidence and abstraction, and test planning through subgoals, experimentation, and recovery. Our dataset is available at [https://arc3-human-think-aloud.github.io/](https://arc3-human-think-aloud.github.io/).
arxiv.comment: 21 pages, 14 figures
arxiv.titleZh: 人类如何学习陌生的世界：一个关于 ARC-AGI-3 的出声思维数据集
arxiv.summaryZh: 以 ARC-AGI-3 为试验台，构建了首个记录人类如何发现并使用陌生环境机制的数据集：25 个公开游戏上 64 名参与者的 144 条轨迹，动作与出声思维音频时间同步，另有 250 条带或不带 harness 的 LLM agent 轨迹；标注机制触发与识别、动作意图、错误与恢复，把理解的变化对应到具体的观察与动作。结果显示两组都会预判机制、借用熟悉类比；成功人类轨迹中定性表征占 50.0%，成功 LLM 轨迹仅 14.3%，人类更常在没有明确假设时探索，假设检验则两组都常见。研究还刻画了由信念修正、重新规划与执行纠错构成的恢复过程，为在 harness 完善的 LLM 已接近饱和的公开游戏之外设计新 benchmark 提供依据。

arxiv.title: Ambiguous Fits: The Rashomon Effect and Challenges in Scaling Law Estimation
arxiv.abstract: Estimating neural scaling laws involves an end-to-end pipeline: designing a scaling recipe, training models across scales, evaluating models on a target metric, and deploying an algorithm to fit a scaling law to the resulting data. This final fitting stage is often treated as routine: standard procedures minimize a non-convex fitting loss using local optimization from a grid of initializations, and return the best solution found. Yet such heuristic searches can fail in two distinct ways: they offer no guarantee of returning a nearly optimal solution, and they obscure whether fundamentally different parameter choices fit the data nearly as well. Indeed, we show that standard scaling law fitting is subject to a Rashomon effect (Breiman, 2001): the sublevel sets of near-minimizers correspond to broad parameter regions whose extrapolations diverge substantially at scale. We resolve these issues with a deterministic branch-and-bound algorithm that guarantees nearly optimal fitting loss and exhaustively maps the near-minimizers to the implied range of scaling curves.
arxiv.comment: 31 pages
arxiv.titleZh: 模糊的拟合:缩放定律估计中的 Rashomon 效应与挑战
arxiv.summaryZh: 缩放定律估计的最后一步——用局部优化从初始点网格中搜出最优拟合——通常被当作例行流程，但它既不保证得到接近最优解，也会掩盖参数差异很大却拟合得几乎一样好的解。研究显示标准拟合存在 Rashomon 效应:近优解构成的参数区域很宽，而这些解在大规模外推时差异显著。为此提出确定性分支定界算法，保证拟合损失接近最优，并穷尽地刻画近优解集合所对应的缩放曲线范围。该工作把缩放定律外推从单点预测变为带不确定性的区间估计，适用于预训练算力与数据配比规划。
arxiv.reason: 直击缩放定律拟合的可靠性问题，方法严谨、系统性强

arxiv.title: The Price of Scale in Proactive Memory Recall
arxiv.abstract: A long-lived assistant that brings up memories without being asked must decide at every turn whether anything in its store is worth an interruption. We show that this decision is a multiple-testing problem whose difficulty grows with the store size $N$. On streaming replays of LongMemEval and LoCoMo, a similarity threshold tuned to 5% false alarms at $N=8$ reaches 87-100% at $N=2048$, across embedding models and for explicit and implicit cues; LLM judges show the same growth from a lower base. We prove that a gate with false-alarm rate $α$ operates at a per-item false-positive rate of about $-\ln(1-α)/N$, which pins its hit rate to the far left of the single-comparison ROC curve and, under regular variation, makes it decay as a power of $N$ with an explicit constant. The resulting prediction matches the hit rate of a per-$N$ oracle threshold to within one percentage point. The analysis explains why lexical and semantic channels need thresholds growing like $\ln N$ and $\sqrt{\ln N}$, and why per-cue normalisation roughly doubles the hit rate at matched false alarms. A cue-swap conformal gate, which compares the current cue with the user's other cues on the same store, needs no labels and has a finite-sample false-alarm guarantee under exchangeability; on LongMemEval it holds false alarms near 5% at the hit rate of a label-tuned threshold. Three annotators (Fleiss' $κ=0.63$) find that about nine in ten false alarms are genuine interruptions. Code and data: https://github.com/RiverChenStillCompiling/price-of-scale
arxiv.comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/RiverChenStillCompiling/price-of-scale
arxiv.titleZh: 规模扩张的代价：主动式记忆召回中的多重检验问题
arxiv.summaryZh: 长驻助手主动召回记忆时需判断存储中是否有值得打断用户的内容，该决策实为随存储规模N增长的多重检验问题。在LongMemEval与LoCoMo的流式回放中，按N=8调至5%误报的阈值到N=2048时误报升至87-100%，LLM judge同样增长；作者证明误报率α的门控单项误报约为-ln(1-α)/N，据此预测的命中率与逐N oracle阈值相差不超过1个百分点，并说明词法与语义通道阈值需分别按lnN与√lnN增长。提出的cue-swap conformal gate无需标签，在可交换性下具有限样本误报保证，LongMemEval上误报保持约5%且命中率与标签调优阈值相当。
arxiv.reason: Agent长期记忆主动召回门控，有理论分析与免标签新方法

arxiv.title: Multimodal Requirements Traceability Link Recovery in Industrial Settings
arxiv.abstract: Requirements traceability links support activities such as change-impact analysis, coverage checking, and validation. Industrial requirements can include traceable images, which text-only approaches cannot process directly. For a fixed classifier configuration, binary decisions alone offer no direct way to adjust the balance between missed and incorrect links. We extend a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approach for inter-requirements traceability link recovery (TLR). Our extension retrieves text and image candidates separately, classifies each retrieved pair with a vision-language model, and filters the predicted links by verbalized confidence. We evaluate our approach on three non-overlapping industrial requirement sets and six public text-only datasets. On the industrial test sets, our approach achieves an F1 score of 0.310, compared with 0.114 for our replication of the baseline approach by Hey et al. Our approach recovers links in all four modality combinations while improving text-only F1 on the industrial data and maintaining similar performance on the public datasets, but recovery remains limited by failures to retrieve related text requirements for image queries. Confidence filtering produces link sets with different precision and recall, removing false positives and some correctly recovered links from the unfiltered link set. This study provides industrial evidence on the potential and limitations of a current RAG-based TLR approach for multimodal requirements and identifies cross-modal retrieval as the component to prioritize in further optimization.
arxiv.comment: Accepted to APSEC 2026
arxiv.titleZh: 工业环境下的多模态需求可追溯性链接恢复
arxiv.summaryZh: 工业需求中含可追溯的图像，纯文本方法无法直接处理，固定分类器配置下的二元判定也难以调节漏检与误检的平衡。方法扩展了需求间追溯链接恢复的RAG流程:文本与图像候选分别检索，由视觉语言模型对每个检索对分类，再按言语化置信度过滤预测链接。在三个互不重叠的工业需求集与六个公开纯文本数据集上，工业测试集F1为0.310(复现的Hey等人基线0.114)，四种模态组合均能恢复链接，但图像查询检索不到相关文本需求限制了召回。置信度过滤可得到precision/recall取向不同的链接集，跨模态检索被指出是后续优化重点。
arxiv.reason: LLM用于需求追溯的垂直应用，与核心关注方向仅擦边

arxiv.title: Best Policy Tracking in Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning commonly exhibits non-monotonic performance dynamics in single-task settings. During learning, a sequence of policies is generated whose true performance is unknown and may oscillate significantly across iterations. Despite this well-known phenomenon, standard experimental practice typically reports either the final visited policy or the best among periodically evaluated ones, implicitly assuming that these selection criteria reliably approximate the best-performing policy visited throughout the entire sequence. In this work, we present an empirical study on the implications of non-monotonicity for policy selection in single-task policy-based reinforcement learning. We introduce post-hoc diagnostic metrics to characterize performance degradation and assess the accuracy and efficiency of different selection criteria. These metrics allow us to evaluate commonly used selection strategies across standard continuous-control benchmarks using a well-established on-policy actor-critic method. Our results show that, in this representative experimental setting, widely adopted selection practices can deviate considerably from the best policy encountered during learning, leading to underperforming estimates and suboptimal use of computational resources. As an alternative, we recommend a validation-based policy selection strategy constrained by computational cost, which provides a more consistent and accurate approximation of the best visited policy while improving selection efficiency. Overall, our findings highlight policy selection as an underexplored factor in the evaluation protocols of reinforcement learning and motivate further study on explicit and standardized validation-based selection procedures.
arxiv.comment: Preprint submitted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), https://openreview.net/forum?id=b4BbTUF8Xe
arxiv.titleZh: 强化学习中的最优策略追踪
arxiv.summaryZh: 单任务强化学习训练中策略性能常呈非单调振荡，而通用做法只报告最终策略或周期性评估中的最优者，隐含假设二者能可靠逼近整个训练过程中访问过的最优策略。该工作引入事后诊断指标，量化性能退化并衡量不同选择准则的准确性与计算效率，在标准连续控制基准上用成熟的on-policy actor-critic方法系统比较常见选择策略。结果显示这些做法可能显著偏离真实最优策略，既低估性能又浪费算力；作者推荐一种受计算成本约束、基于验证集的策略选择方案，能更稳定准确地逼近最优访问策略。这提示策略选择是RL评测协议中被低估的环节，对LLM后训练的checkpoint选择同样有借鉴意义。
arxiv.reason: 策略选择与评测方法学扎实，但限于连续控制，与LLM后训练仅间接相关

arxiv.title: CaliMem: Search-Efficient Data Agent via Calibrated Memory
arxiv.abstract: Data curation is a first-order design choice in machine learning, yet tailoring training data to a downstream model and task remains costly in labor, expertise, and compute. Datasets are therefore often processed through fixed pipelines and reused across applications. We show that this assumption is fragile: across 55 dataset--model tasks spanning biological domains, the same curation recipe can help one model while hurting another. Effective curation must adapt to the downstream setting, motivating automated search over data recipes. We first build an agentic system that searches for curation policies at deployment, improving data utility via \textit{test-time curation (TTC)}. Although achieving performance gains, its search is driven largely by recent feedback and remains local. Adding persistent memory helps the agent retain evidence across iterations and reveals a deeper problem: it forms claims that extend beyond the conditions in which they were observed, sometimes abandoning an entire strategy after a single unsuccessful trial. To address this problem, we introduce CaliMem, a calibrated-memory agentic loop that requires the agent to predict the outcome of each proposed policy before executing it. Comparing this prediction with the observed result gives the agent a \textit{reality check} on the claims behind its proposal. It uses the prediction error to retain supported claims, revise mistaken ones, and specify the conditions under which a conclusion holds. This makes the agent's beliefs testable, reduces overgeneralization, and supports more effective long-horizon exploration. Across biological and LLM post-training tasks, CaliMem consistently outperforms fixed curation baselines and published methods, and exceeds full-data training by up to 19.4\%. Code is open-sourced.
arxiv.titleZh: CaliMem：基于校准记忆的搜索高效数据智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 数据配方的效果会随下游模型与任务而变：在 55 个数据集-模型任务上，同一套策展流程可能提升一个模型的表现，却损害另一个模型，因此需要在部署时自动搜索数据配方。该工作先构建 agentic 系统进行 test-time curation，并加入持久记忆来保留历史证据；但随后发现，智能体会把单次实验得出的结论过度泛化。CaliMem 要求智能体在执行每条候选策略前先预测其结果，再用预测误差做“现实检验”，保留有证据支持的结论、修正错误结论，并标注结论成立的条件。在生物与 LLM 后训练任务上，它稳定优于固定流程与已发表方法，相比全量数据训练最高提升 19.4%。
arxiv.reason: Agent 记忆校准叠加后训练数据策展，方法新颖且实验扎实

arxiv.title: Does the Voynich Manuscript Mean Anything? Calibrated Tests Find Little Trace of Language
arxiv.abstract: The Voynich manuscript is a fifteenth-century book in a script that no one can read. One account holds that its text means nothing and that a scribe made it by copying his own words and changing them a little. The other holds that a real language lies hidden behind a cipher. We write each account as a program that fills the pages of the manuscript, fit every program with the same budget, and check it on statistics the fit never saw. The copying process of Timm and Schinner predicts these statistics far better than any cipher with one key. But ciphers that switch keys between the manuscript's two dialects, or that encode only the word classes of a real text, predict them equally well. Word statistics alone cannot decide. We look for a trace of language that needs no decipherment. In 28 texts in 16 languages the same word pairs keep sharing a line. The manuscript shows this pattern at half the strength of the weakest of these texts. A word code keeps the pattern above the manuscript unless its plaintext has a weak pattern or many words are miscopied. Solvers that decipher control texts find no readable text in the manuscript under a letter cipher, a word code or 28 codes with one letter, letter pair or syllable per word. Word codes of abbreviated Latin, the plaintext their fits prefer, show which word follows which more clearly than the manuscript unless two words in five are miscopied. One cipher remains possible, a nomenclator with a second key whose scribe miscopies more than half of the words, and our solvers cannot exclude it in 9 of 16 languages. Most of the structure a solver finds comes from how the end of one word shapes the start of the next, which reflects how tightly glyphs are bound to each other. Planted messages are found reliably only when they are long, each letter always becomes the same word and these words are adjacent, so other messages could hide.
arxiv.titleZh: 《伏尼契手稿》有意义吗？校准检验几乎未发现语言痕迹
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对15世纪《伏尼契手稿》是无意义抄写还是加密真实语言的争论，将两种假说写成页面生成程序，以同等预算拟合，并在未见统计量上检验。Timm-Schinner复制过程比单密钥密码更好地预测统计量，但跨方言切换密钥或仅编码词类的密码同样好，词统计无法定论。进一步在16种语言的28篇文本中发现稳定的跨行词对共现模式，手稿仅达最弱文本一半强度；字母密码、词码等求解器能解开对照文本，却未从手稿恢复可读文本。除需第二密钥且过半词误抄的命名密码外，多数证据不支持存在可破译语言。
arxiv.reason: 历史手稿统计破译，与LLM后训练、Agent方向无交集

arxiv.title: Approximate Unlearning in Prototype-based-classifiers
arxiv.abstract: The recent data and AI regulations and governance needs have highlighted the need for removing specific data even from models trained on or with them. While retraining the entire model is a theoretically trivial solution, it is computationally expensive, thereby motivating research in Machine Unlearning. This paper introduces a robust approximate unlearning technique for the family of prototype-based classifiers called Generalized Learning Vector Quantization, aimed at removal of effects of specified samples, either due to deletion request or due to them being identified as noisy or corrupt. We first show the impact of the different sizes of the forget set, as well as the characteristics of the data in this set, on the unlearned model. To address the sources of instabilities detected in this unlearning method we propose an adapted version of this technique, such that the unlearning is robust to the characteristics of the forget set. Thereafter using the intrinsic interpretability property of GLVQ and appropriate metrics defined in unlearning literature, we show the efficacy (approximately 0 deviation of parameters and performance of unlearned model relative to retrained model) and efficiency (6X for smallest dataset to 10^(5)X in the largest dataset) of the proposed unlearning techniques compared to naive retrained, on six benchmark datasets for tabular data recommended by literature. Although in this work we investigated only binary class problems, the proposed robust unlearning strategy can be readily applied for removing sample effects from any trained GLVQ model, i.e., it does not require any modification in the training scheme of GLVQ.
arxiv.comment: Submitted at the moment to Knowledge-Based Systems
arxiv.titleZh: 原型分类器中的近似遗忘
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对原型分类器广义学习矢量量化（GLVQ）的数据删除需求，提出一种稳健的近似机器遗忘方法：先分析遗忘集大小与数据特性对遗忘效果的影响，再针对不稳定来源改造遗忘流程，使其对遗忘集特征更稳健。基于GLVQ的内在可解释性与遗忘评价指标，在六个表格数据基准的二分类任务上验证，遗忘后参数与性能相对重训练模型的偏差约等于零，效率较朴素重训练提升6倍至10^5倍。该方法无需改动GLVQ训练流程，可推广到任意已训练GLVQ模型。

arxiv.title: What Effort Level Should I Choose? On the Economics of Reasoning Effort in LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: Generative models increasingly expose a reasoning effort setting that lets users scale inference-time compute, trading higher cost for potentially improved performance. Users must choose an effort level before knowing whether extra reasoning will help, and even a successful run does not reveal whether the effort purchased was necessary. Reasoning effort is therefore a credence good: buyers observe the outcome but cannot assess the marginal value of the computation they paid for. In this work, we measure the counterfactual effect of effort levels on both proprietary and open-weight models on four benchmarks, spanning single-call reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks. Effort, it turns out, does not consistently preserve tasks that lower effort solves, can overspend, and can change trajectory behavior. First, we find that although higher effort can raise accuracy in aggregate, it frequently fails on tasks that lower effort solved. Second, on the subset of easy tasks that every effort level solves, higher effort is generally more costly, with the highest effort level costing up to 42x as much as the lowest. Lastly, effort changes not only how many tokens are used, but also how agents solve tasks: at higher effort, agents verify their own work more heavily and more often search for solutions than work through problems directly, both of which lengthen trajectories without necessarily altering the outcome. These findings show that naively choosing the highest level is not only cost-inefficient but also offers no guarantee of the best instance-level performance. A simple alternative, starting at the lowest effort and escalating only after a verified failure, matches or improves on fixed top effort across all models and benchmarks at lower cost for most proprietary models.
arxiv.titleZh: 我该选择哪个努力档位?论 LLM Agent 中推理努力的经济学
arxiv.summaryZh: 推理努力(reasoning effort)档位要求用户预付费买算力，却无法预知或事后判断这份算力是否必要，属信任品问题。在四个基准上对闭源与开源权重模型做反事实测量，覆盖单次推理与长程 Agent 任务:更高档位总体提升准确率，却常在低档位已解出的任务上失败;在所有档位都能解决的简单任务上，最高档成本可达最低档的 42 倍，并改变轨迹行为——更多自我验证与搜索，拉长轨迹却不改结果。据此提出从最低档起步、仅在验证失败后升档的策略，在多数闭源模型上以更低成本匹配或超过固定最高档。
arxiv.reason: 推理努力档位的成本-效果实测，直击 test-time scaling 与 Agent 效率

arxiv.title: Efficient Proof Generation for Lean Statements with Multiple Candidate Answers
arxiv.abstract: In formal systems such as Lean 4, efficiently finding answers to mathematical problems and generating verifiable proofs is an important task in automated mathematical reasoning. In the traditional way where an upstream solver provides multiple candidate answers, the common workflow requires searching for proofs for each candidate separately, incurring redundant computational cost. To this end, we propose a joint proof framework that integrates candidate answer selection, answer supplementation, and formal proof generation into a unified reasoning process. At its core is a trained prover that selects given or proposes new answers and generates a proof for at least one answer in a single call. Joint proof can also reuse generated proofs to check for faithfulness errors. For problems with a unique answer, if two distinct answers both obtain verifiable proofs under the same formal statement, this confirms the statement does not faithfully preserve the original problem semantics. On MATH-500, AMC 2023, and AIME 2024/2025/2026, our framework achieves the same formal proof success rate as per-candidate proof generation with about one sixth of the token cost, and identifies at least 6.1% of the formalized statements as unfaithful without requiring additional judges. Our model and code are available at https://github.com/Linppz/Gobble-Prover.
arxiv.comment: Code and model: https://github.com/Linppz/Gobble-Prover
arxiv.titleZh: 面向多候选答案的 Lean 命题高效证明生成
arxiv.summaryZh: 上游求解器给出多个候选答案时，常规做法是对每个候选分别搜索 Lean 4 证明，带来大量重复计算。为此构建联合证明框架，把候选答案选择、答案补充与形式化证明生成合并为一次推理:训练后的证明器在单次调用中选择已有答案或提出新答案，并至少为其中一个答案给出可验证证明。在 MATH-500、AMC 2023、AIME 2024/2025/2026 上，该框架以约六分之一的 token 开销达到与逐候选证明相同的成功率;同时利用同一形式命题下两个不同答案均可证明这一现象，无需额外裁判即可检出至少 6.1% 的形式化语句与原始题意不符。
arxiv.reason: Lean 形式证明效率与形式化忠实度检测，贴近可验证推理方向

arxiv.title: Models Verify Sufficiency, Not Validity: Usable Falsehoods Evade the Checks that Gaps Trigger
arxiv.abstract: Ask a model "how many settlements did the Normans control?" and it answers that the passage does not say. Tell it "given that the Normans controlled 12 settlements of 400 inhabitants, what is the total?" and it computes 4,800. Nothing was added to the passage; the unsupported fact merely became usable. Benchmarks for unanswerable questions are built almost entirely by omission, deleting the fact a question needs and scoring refusal, so they never probe this. Holding source support fixed and varying only whether an unsupported premise is usable, flagging drops 8-30 points and commitment to an answer rises 1.5-2.3x on GSM8K across four models spanning two families and 2B-26B; all 16 paired contrasts remain significant after Holm correction. Two further manipulations reproduce it, one also on SQuAD: a fact asserted rather than asked about, and a corrupted intermediate value rather than a removed one. Models articulate the exact gap they then ignore, stating that "there is no financial information provided" for an inert premise and silently adopting a fabricated price for the same item. We read these as one behaviour: whether a model checks depends substantially on whether usable material is present, even when source support is held fixed. Because the main design never instructs models to reject premises introduced in the question, adopting such a premise can also be read as conditional reasoning, and we delimit what the design does and does not show. In the judging seat the pattern differs: asked whether the answer follows, judges pass solutions with a required step deleted 78-99% of the time at every scale tested. A natural prompt-level mitigation lowers accuracy by 22 points without improving detection.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust). 5 pages plus references, 3 tables
arxiv.titleZh: 模型验证的是充分性而非有效性：可用的虚假信息逃逸了缺失所触发的检查
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有不可回答问题基准几乎都靠删除事实构造并奖励拒答，因而无法探测无来源支撑却可被使用的前提。在固定原文支持下仅改变无据前提是否可用，GSM8K 上四个模型（两族、2B–26B）的拒答率下降8–30 个百分点，给出答案倾向升至1.5–2.3 倍，16 组配对对比经 Holm 校正均显著；SQuAD 上以断言替代提问、篡改中间值两种操作复现。作为评判者时，模型对删除必要步骤的解答仍有78–99% 判为通过，提示层面缓解使准确率降22 点却未提升检测。模型是否核查取决于有无可用材料，对不可回答问题评测与LLM-as-judge可靠性有直接意义。

arxiv.title: From Outranking Flow Scores to Linear Programs: Group Decision Making in PROMETHEE II
arxiv.abstract: We study inverse and consensus analysis for PROMETHEE II ranking problems when the performance table is fixed. Existing approaches in PROMETHEE-based sensitivity and consensus analysis usually focus on deviations of criteria weights while treating preference functions as fixed. Nevertheless both sets of parameters jointly determine the outranking flow scores. We introduce a linear reparametrization of the PROMETHEE II net flow scores based on weighted preference increments over the observed differences of performances. This representation yields a linear expression of the net flows and clarifies how weights and preference functions interact. Building on this result, we derive linear optimization models for three settings: minimizing weight deviations while allowing preference functions to vary; minimizing deviations over the full set of preference parameters; and multiple decision-maker consensus analysis (with objectives based either on total deviation or on the maximal individual deviation to promote fairness). An illustrative example shows that allowing preference functions to vary can dramatically change the inverse-analysis conclusions obtained from weight-only models, and that the proposed group formulations distinguish efficient consensuses from fairer ones.
arxiv.comment: 15 pages; 1 figure; to be published in Algorithmic Decision Theory, 9th International Conference, ADT 2026, Lecture Notes in Computer Science
arxiv.titleZh: 从超越流分数到线性规划：PROMETHEE II 中的群决策
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对性能表固定时的 PROMETHEE II 排序逆分析与共识分析，提出基于观测性能差的加权偏好增量的线性重参数化，将净流分数写成线性表达式，从而显式刻画权重与偏好函数的交互。由此构建三类线性优化模型：允许偏好函数变化时最小化权重偏差、在全部偏好参数上最小化偏差，以及面向多决策者的共识分析（以总偏差或最大个体偏差为目标以促进公平）。示例表明，允许偏好函数变化会显著改变仅调权重的逆分析结论，且所提群决策模型能区分高效共识与更公平的共识。

arxiv.title: Finite-Sample Sensitivity of Kernel Metrics for Generative Evaluation
arxiv.abstract: Kernel distances such as the Kernel Inception Distance (KID) and the Kernel Audio Distance (KAD) compare generated and reference samples in an embedding space, and model comparisons rest on their values. Each ships with one fixed kernel, and a reported value does not say which changes that kernel detects at the sample size used. We run each default as a permutation two-sample test on real embeddings of symbolic music, audio and images, comparing a sample with an independent sample changed by a mean shift, an isotropic contraction, or a rotation that keeps the mean and the covariance trace and is matched to the shift in transport distance. At 780 samples per side, both defaults rarely detect the rotations in five evaluation spaces, while they detect the shifts in every run. The median-bandwidth Gaussian kernel of KAD detects the contraction and regains power against rotations on image embeddings with an order of magnitude more samples. The cubic kernel of KID contains second- and third-moment information but misses the contraction in most runs, and our experiments do not establish a high-power rotation regime for it over the tested sample sizes. Narrower Gaussian bandwidths restore sensitivity in music and audio, an $\ell_1$ Laplace kernel does so for images, and aggregated tests combine both at nominal level. We recommend that a reported kernel distance state its sample budget and the changes its configuration detects at that budget.
arxiv.comment: 21 pages, 2 figures, 20 tables
arxiv.titleZh: 生成式评估中核指标的有限样本敏感性
arxiv.summaryZh: KID、KAD等核距离在固定核与固定样本量下给出一个数值，却无法说明该配置在所用样本量下能检测到哪类分布变化。工作将默认配置作为置换双样本检验，在符号音乐、音频与图像的嵌入上对比均值漂移、各向同性收缩，以及与漂移在传输距离上匹配、保持均值与协方差迹的旋转。每侧780个样本时，两种默认核几乎检测不到旋转，但对均值漂移每次都能检出;KAD的中位数带宽高斯核可检出收缩，并在样本量高一个数量级时恢复对旋转的检验力，而KID的三次核在多数运行中漏检收缩。窄带宽高斯核在音乐与音频上恢复敏感性，ℓ1拉普拉斯核适用于图像。作者建议报告核距离时同时注明样本预算与该预算下可检测的变化。

arxiv.title: From Explaining to Enabling: Actionable Transparency in Algorithmic Insurance Pricing
arxiv.abstract: Machine learning (ML) systems increasingly make consequential decisions about individuals, including credit, hiring, and insurance. Research on ML-driven insurance pricing has asked how the pricing mechanism itself can be made accountable. Yet it remains unclear how an individual policyholder's algorithmically determined premium should be explained to them. We argue that a useful explanation must be valid, actionable, and reliable. A valid recommendation lowers the premium according to the model. An actionable recommendation changes only characteristics the policyholder can control. A reliable recommendation has an actual outcome that is likely to meet the target, even in sparsely observed regions of the feature space where the model is uncertain. We formalize these three requirements as axioms and develop a method that turns an algorithmic premium into recommendations that meet them. The method meets the third requirement with a Conformal Prediction constraint, which screens out recommendations that the model is too uncertain about and thereby bounds the rate of unreliable recommendations. We apply four Counterfactual Explanation techniques to 57,832 real Florida flood-insurance claims and 98,058 synthetic driver-telematics policies. We adapt these techniques for insurance applications, so that their recommendations change only controllable characteristics and resemble policyholders observed in the data. In our illustrations, the constrained recommendations for high-risk policyholders are both more reliable and associated with larger predicted risk reductions than the unconstrained ones. These results suggest that insurers can give policyholders explanations that are both actionable and trustworthy. The work contributes to research on algorithmic accountability and offers implications for insurers and regulators.
arxiv.titleZh: 从解释到赋能:算法保险定价中的可行动透明性
arxiv.summaryZh: 算法定价的保单持有人需要能据此改变保费的说明，而现有可解释性研究很少同时保证说明有效、可行动且可靠。该工作把这三项要求形式化为公理，用 Conformal Prediction 约束筛掉模型不确定性过高的反事实建议，从而限制不可靠建议的比例，并适配四种反事实解释方法使其只改动可控特征。在 57,832 条佛罗里达洪水保险真实理赔与 98,058 条合成车险 telematics 保单上，受约束建议对高风险投保人更可靠，预测风险降幅也更大。

arxiv.title: EvolveMAS: A Unified Self-Evolution Framework for Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems
arxiv.abstract: Decentralized multi-agent systems (MAS) enable large language model agents to interact without centralized control. Agents need to adapt to other agents at test time and reuse accumulated experience to refine their interaction strategies for future interactions across cooperative, mixed-motive, and adversarial settings. However, existing approaches often develop adaptation mechanisms for particular interaction settings. This raises a central question: how can decentralized MAS support test-time adaptation and reliable experience reuse across interaction settings? We propose EvolveMAS, a unified self-evolution framework that supports experience-driven adaptation within and across episodes. EvolveMAS pairs each main agent with a dedicated MemoryAgent for test-time memory governance, which maintains isolated Structured Memory outside the main agent's reasoning context. EvolveMAS organizes adaptation into two complementary processes: Within-Episode Online Adaptation and Cross-Episode Knowledge Evolution. During Within-Episode Online Adaptation, MemoryAgent updates episodic, semantic, and working memory from interaction evidence to inform subsequent actions. During Cross-Episode Knowledge Evolution, the main agent uses memory and episode outcomes to distill reusable interaction knowledge comprising partner profiles and interaction strategies for subsequent episodes. Across five benchmarks and six evaluation configurations spanning the three interaction settings, EvolveMAS achieves the highest normalized average score of 77.2 among the compared methods. Ablations show that test-time memory governance and cross-episode knowledge reuse both improve performance. Interaction traces further illustrate how updated memory and distilled knowledge guide subsequent interactions. These results support experience-driven adaptation in decentralized MAS without updating model parameters.
arxiv.comment: 27 pages, 9 figures
arxiv.titleZh: EvolveMAS：去中心化多智能体系统的统一自我进化框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 去中心化多智能体系统需要智能体在测试时适应其他智能体，并复用积累的经验，但已有方法往往只覆盖合作、混合动机或对抗中的单一设定。EvolveMAS为每个主智能体配备独立的MemoryAgent，在主智能体推理上下文之外维护隔离的结构化记忆，并把适应拆成两个互补过程：回合内在线适应更新情景、语义与工作记忆，跨回合知识进化蒸馏可复用的伙伴画像与交互策略。在覆盖三类设定的5个基准、6种评测配置上取得最高的归一化平均分77.2，消融显示测试时记忆治理与跨回合知识复用均有增益，且全程不更新模型参数。
